mapper.select: SELECT i.*, p.name AS pet_name, cc.card_no AS card_no FROM bill_item i LEFT JOIN pet p ON p.id = i.pet_id LEFT JOIN customer_card cc ON cc.id = i.card_id WHERE i.bill_id = #{billId} ORDER BY i.sort_no, i.id

SELECT i.*, p.name AS pet_name, cc.card_no AS card_no FROM bill_item i LEFT JOIN pet p ON p.id = i.pet_id LEFT JOIN customer_card cc ON cc.id = i.card_id WHERE i.bill_id = #{billId} AND i.item_type = 'PRODUCT' ORDER BY i.sort_no, i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill_item(bill_id, item_type, ref_id, name_snapshot, size_tier, pet_id, qty, unit_price_cent, amount_cent, discount_cent, paid_by_card, card_id, sort_no) VALUES (#{billId}, #{itemType}, #{refId}, #{nameSnapshot}, #{sizeTier}, #{petId}, #{qty}, #{unitPriceCent}, #{amountCent}, #{discountCent}, #{paidByCard}, #{cardId}, #{sortNo})
